what: AR17: the Strip's own pieces. Made as the base's kit is, and wearing the base kit's own pair of pictures.
frame: Roblox's: a piece's front (Blender +Y) is -Z. A MeshPart goes at the piece's place times `centre`. A light's `at` is in the piece's own frame.
surface: one SurfaceAppearance per MeshPart, the base kit's: ColorMap Base_Kit_Color, EmissiveMaskContent Base_Kit_Glow, EmissiveTint `glowTint`, EmissiveStrength from `glowStrength` (the base kit's own, tuned in the engine; CrossingShard's is 2.5 times the kit's before AR20's lift, so its light carries to a far gate: when Config.Lighting lifts the kit's glow for the base and the Strip, the shard keeps this strength and takes none of the lift, or it blooms into a halo at night). Single sided; the void stone's ink is in its mesh.

maps.maps/Strip_Paving_Color.png: the Strip's stones: Lantern Row's paving, 1.35 times its light (AR20's C), its stones moved to #F2EDE4 by day and its joints to #B2946C (AR40's C), a tile 8 studs square for a Texture on the street's Part
maps.../Base/maps/Base_Deck_Color.png: an empty lot's floor, the base's plain deck tinted #6E7290 (the Texture's Color3), a tile 8 studs square

shadows: CastShadow off on the three cracks, CrossingMark and the far shards.

StripPost.collision: the foot, 1.7 square, and the stone
StripPost.note: 10.2 high. Its shard hangs in its ring 2 out toward +X and 7.7 up: turn the post so +X looks at the street's middle. A PointLight at Lamp only where the plan lights one; the shard glows anyway

VeinWide.note: a crack of the void's power, warm white in a teal edge on a dark bed, flat in the stones, 30 long from its back to its front. The wide one, for near the crossing: 2.2 at its widest, two side cracks. It glows without a Light. No shadow. Look only: it lies 0.07 over the floor

VeinThin.note: a crack of the void's power, warm white in a teal edge on a dark bed, flat in the stones, 30 long from its back to its front. The thin one, for far down the street: 0.8 at its widest, one side crack. It glows without a Light. No shadow. Look only: it lies 0.07 over the floor

VeinBranch.note: a crack of the void's power, warm white in a teal edge on a dark bed, flat in the stones, 21 long from its back to its front. A branch from the street's crack to a gate, thinner and dimmer than the street's own: 0.36 at its widest, thinning toward its front. It glows without a Light. No shadow. Look only: it lies 0.07 over the floor

CrossingShard.collision: none: it hangs 8.5 over the floor, and players walk under it
CrossingShard.note: hangs over the crossing's mark, from 8.5 to 46 over the floor, about 17 across. Its three parts are void stone; the road's warm light inside them and the four small violet shards glow. One PointLight at Heart. It may turn slowly and rise and fall a little, the builder's call. A place for the Void Rift to open, if research wants one: the piece asks for nothing

ShardOutcrop.collision: the tallest shard, as a post 2 square, if anything
ShardOutcrop.note: shards breaking out of the ground, 7.6 high and about 6 across: five of teal glass, lit at the head so none stands black against the day sky (AR20, AR40), and one small one of the void's violet light, which glows without a Light. Turned as the plan says, no two look alike

SealCalamity.collision: a wall across the whole street: 48 wide, 5 deep, as high as it needs
SealCalamity.note: stands across the Strip's end toward the Calamity, its front (+Y) looking back down the street. 49.5 high at its shard, the two stones 30.5, the shut way 20 wide and 38 to its point. Shut and dim: only the seam, the arch's edge, the lock's shard and the shard over the keystone glow. One PointLight at Shard if the phone's count allows. It opens in its own phase

SealClash.collision: a wall across the whole street: 48 wide, 5 deep, as high as it needs
SealClash.note: stands across the Strip's end toward the Clash Grounds, its front (+Y) looking back down the street. 49.5 high at its shard, the two stones 30.5, the shut way 20 wide and 38 to its point. Shut and dim: only the seam, the arch's edge, the lock's shard and the shard over the keystone glow. One PointLight at Shard if the phone's count allows. It opens in its own phase

CrossingMark.note: lies 0.06 over the stones at the crossing's middle, 39.8 across: a ring, and a well of full black ringed in the void's light 9 out, where the street's cracks end, with nothing in it. The inner ring glows. No shadow. Look only

FarShardLow.note: a great shard of teal glass, 80 high and 16 wide, far past the map's edge: unlit, in a pale teal painted for the distance, since no haze pales it now (AR20). It leans a little toward +X, and its foot goes 30 under the floor, for where the ground has ended. No hull, no shadow, nobody reaches it

FarShardMid.note: a great shard of teal glass, 125 high and 22 wide, far past the map's edge: unlit, in a pale teal painted for the distance, since no haze pales it now (AR20). It leans a little toward +X, and its foot goes 30 under the floor, for where the ground has ended. No hull, no shadow, nobody reaches it

VoidShop.collision: the counter, 16 by 2.4 by 3.2, and the three stones at its back; the slab hangs out of reach
VoidShop.note: stands at the Shop's place in WorldService (4 into its lot from the Strip's edge), its front (+Y) looking at the Strip. The slab hangs from 10.9 to 13.5, 39.4 across and 16.8 deep, its front edge a blade's. Only the counter's edge and the shelf's two shards (the Standard shards, D6) glow: the counter's own light, over the clock's. The cradle between them stays dark; a featured stock's light in it is VoidShopCrown's. One PointLight at Counter, white. The clock's light and the crown are their own pieces, VoidShopMinute (five) and VoidShopCrown

VoidShopMinute.note: its origin is its root, in the slab's underside, and it hangs 6.1 down from it. Five stand on the VoidShop's own turn, at its frame's across 17, 14, 11, 8, 5, along -5.9, up 12.2: the first minute at 17. A minute still to run shows; a spent one is hidden. The running one shows the share of its minute left: its height (the MeshPart's Y) times that share, its root kept where it is. Its lit face glows under the counter's light (research, 21:41), in a dark rim that also covers its back. No collision

VoidShopCrown.note: stands on the VoidShop's own place and turn: round its slab's edge, and a stone of light in the shelf's cradle. Shown only while a featured stock is in (D6), for its five minutes; hidden otherwise. Its glow is the brightest of the Shop's, so a lit crown reads from far down the Strip and the side street. One PointLight at Crown while it's lit, if the phone's count allows. No collision
